text:
alice: Kicking v2 rollforward for canary region (us-west) now. Deploybot is starting canary wave.

deploy-bot: deploy started: v2.3.1 -> canary(us-west) 
  steps: build -> push -> warmup -> shift 10%

ben: watching probes/latency. will report 1m metrics.

carol: reminder: mobile SDKs still on v1 by default, we only shift web for this wave.

deploy-bot: warmup ok, kv-cache primed, shift to 10% traffic in 3 hosts.

ben: seeing small increase in 500s on proxy-edge (3% -> 1.8%). unclear if noise.

alice: copy that. hold at 10% until we confirm telemetry for 10m.

dave: quick check — did we enable header-normalize flag? last time charset clients tripped.

erin: flag is off in canary per config: `feature.header_normalize=false`

carol: if header normalization is off, fallback routing could mis-handle client-sent version header casing. might explain 5xx on some mobile UA.

ben: digging into logs, 2 tenants show `invalid version` errors. stack traces point to gateway header parsing. attaching example: `ERROR: parse_version: unknown token "V2"`

alice: okay pause further shifts. ops-bot, can you stop at current wave and prevent auto-wedge?

ops-bot: auto-wedge prevented. canary remains at 10%.

deploy-bot: rolling back rollout step cancelled. no further traffic shifts scheduled.

dave: proposal: two options — 1) enable header_normalize in canary (quick toggle) + resume; 2) rollback canary to v1 for affected tenants and push hotfix for header parsing.

carol: prefer minimize customer impact: enable header_normalize first (low-risk toggle) and run 10m smoke set. if fails, plan 2.

erin: small caveat — header_normalize interacts with legacy auth header shape for partner X. I can patch a denylist for partner X then toggle. takes ~8m.

alice: go for it. erin — apply denylist, toggle header_normalize, we will observe for 10m. ben keep an eye on 5xx and latencies.

erin: applied denylist for partner-X. toggling `feature.header_normalize=true` now.

deploy-bot: feature flag update propagated to canary.

ben: early signal: 500s back to baseline for the two tenants, latency unchanged. no new errors.

alice: nice. safe to continue slow shift to 25% in 5 minutes if stable. No mobile push.

carol: update release notes: add note about header normalization toggle and partner-X denylist. also call out migration guidance for SDK teams.

dave: I'll draft the quick rollback playbook in case we see recurrence — pin client header signal -> route to v1 -> operator alert.

alice: assign follow-ups: carol update release notes + docs, dave write rollback runbook, ben monitor for 30m, erin validate partner-X traffic, I will do operator handoff at 15:30.

ops-bot: handoff scheduled: operator oncall @dave at 15:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: proceeding to 25% in 4m. will post updates. :rocket:

ben: watching. ping me if 5xx > 1% over baseline.

carol: added release-note snippet to PR #4721, labeled `release-docs`.

alice: thanks team. keep messages short in this thread; escalate to #incidents if we need cross-org engagement.

dave: acknowledged. copying runbook link when done.

alice: last note — remember to tag the SDK owners for release-note heads up.

carol: pinged @sdk-team on the PR.

ben: all green at 25% after 12m. no anomalies.

alice: good. continuing staged rollout per plan. operator handoff in place. thread closed unless anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
